composition.anchor: Use each asset anchor_normalized; keep geographic foot fixed when scaling.
composition.badge_position: lower-right outside character; separate from state label
composition.animation: Optional in application; review uses static states and honors reduced motion.

notes: Size factors preserve existing MushroomIcons.scale behavior; sizes are visual cues, not map distances.
CSS is an executable visual design reference, not Android/iOS runtime code.
States communicate shape and text as well as color.
All 15 mushroom types share this system; do not generate separate character art for each state.
All mushroom sources have natural plain stalks without anthropomorphic features.
